bio: The View from The Shard experience takes you sky high to the top of Western Europe's tallest building. Standing 800ft tall, this incredible London landmark is almost twice as high as any other vantage point in the city, boasting amazing 360 degree views.  Buy vouchers for 'The View from The Shard' including Afternoon Tea at a nearby hotel or restaurant.  Afternoon Tea is also served at Aqua Shard on Level 31 within the Shard, but please note that this does not allow access to The View from The Shard, which has a seperate entrance and admission charge.
